items.title: Jane Bunnett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 25, 2024
items.q: I don’t know if you ever knew Fred Taylor, a wonderful man who booked Sculler’s in Cambridge, Massachusetts

ctx.x: And I love playing for dancers. I think it effects the band positively if things are in sync.

It’s really true. I like playing for dancers too. Yeah, I really do. Yeah a lot of the time at our shows people will get up and dance, it depends on the particular city. Some cities are more — have a tendency to more kind of hippies and those folks come out. But yeah, I mean I remember Barry Harris and I think a lot of other musicians of that era, the late Barry Harris saying that you know when people stop dancing, you know when the bebop started to really develop people stopped dancing and that was a really…
When you get in the studio with your group, do you have a technique to create the kind of spirit that happens live?
